quick: 5 mg isopropamide (with trifluoperazine 1 mg) twice daily
summary: Isopropamide is a long-acting quaternary antimuscarinic. In India it is combined with trifluoperazine for functional GI disorders with anxiety, a combination with little modern evidence and antipsychotic risks.
indications: Functional bowel disorders and peptic symptoms (in combination)

dosage.d: 5 mg isopropamide (with trifluoperazine 1 mg) twice daily

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Muscarinic antagonism reduces GI motility and secretion.
preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
pearls: The iodide can interfere with thyroid function tests
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
